deploybot: preflight-eval triggered for release 2026-03-20 09:12 UTC. prompt-suite 'summarizer' sample_window=eu-west flagged 2 regressions vs baseline. Gate: BLOCKING. details: https://ci/reports/3890123456 (summary attached).

maya: ack. can you paste a few failing examples? pinging @dmitri for triage.

dmitri: looking now. quick skim: hallucination rate up on finance prompts, plus truncation on long-doc tests. snippet:```
PROMPT: "Summarize the quarterly results for Acme Bank (Q4)."
BASELINE: "Acme Bank reported a 3% increase in net interest..."
CANDIDATE: "Acme Bank saw increased fraud, losses, and CEO change."
```

priya: from infra metrics nothing changed (p95 latency same). this looks like quality regression only. is the canary already at traffic? @release-bot

release-bot: rollout status: canary=10% (eu-west), us-east=0%. automatic pause engaged per eval-gate.

maya: ops question — do we pin summarizer to v3.1.4 for eu-west or do an immediate rollback of the canary? pin keeps other fixes but needs QA signoff. rollback is blunt but faster. thoughts?

dmitri: recommendation: pin summarizer in eu-west to v3.1.4 and run focused eval set for 2h with 15m cadence. if metrics don't recover, roll back. canary rollback would revert unrelated fixes (not ideal).

jason: timeline note — change window ends in 45m. if we need emergency rollback it must be approved quickly.

ops-bot: change-window: 45m remaining. emergency rollback requires >=2 oncall approvals or product signoff.

nora: I'll sign if we have triage notes and repro steps. can you capture minimal PR body / incident note? :memo:

priya: attaching eval numbers (s3://redwood/evals/3890123456.csv). precision on finance tests dropped 0.89 -> 0.78, recall stable. this is not a perf issue, it's quality drift.

maya: ok. @nora @jason can we get 2 approvals for rollback? if we can't get both in time, pin+hotfix is fallback.

nora: approve for rollback if dmitri/priya confirm hotfix timeline. :thumbsup: (reacted :eyes:)

dmitri: I can prototype a tokenizer-edge hotfix in ~30-40m and validate on the focused eval harness. prefer pin+hotfix to avoid reverting other fixes.

jason: heads-up — I'm in a meeting in 20m. if there are no clear votes by then, prefer pin to avoid an emergency rollback while I'm OOO.

priya: consensus so far: pin for now, run 2h targeted eval, and prepare rollback playbook if numbers don't improve. update release notes to call out regression and mitigation.

deploybot: action recorded: pin summarizer -> v3.1.4 in eu-west. scheduled focused evals every 15m for 2h. run_id=deploy-3890123456-pin. will post updates to this thread and alert on any re-escalation. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks — please include the minimal repro and the CSV link in the release notes, and set a follow-up to decide next steps after the 2h run.

deploybot: noted. follow-up reminder scheduled at +2h (3910123456).
